annotation.interpretation_b: Alternatively, the clause could be interpreted as requiring that the set include all protocol versions that the token is expected to support, implying an exhaustive list.
annotation.justification: The clause lacks a concrete constraint on the cardinality or completeness of the set of protocol‑version tokens, permitting materially different implementation behaviours.
